props.heading: Train smart. Show up. Get stronger.
props.sub: A well-equipped, no-nonsense gym in JP Nagar, Bengaluru. 8,000 sq ft of training space, certified coaches, and a community that keeps you coming back — whether you are picking up a barbell for the first time or prepping for a competition.

props.label: By the Numbers
props.heading: Built on trust, not tall claims

props.label: Our Story
props.heading: Consistency meets community
props.body:
Iron Bridge Fitness opened in 2018 with a straightforward idea: build a gym where people actually want to train every day. No intimidation, no fad programs, no hidden fees. Just good equipment, knowledgeable coaches, and a clean, well-lit space.

We are independently owned and operated — not a franchise. Every piece of equipment and every programme is chosen by people who train here themselves. Our members range from first-time gym-goers in their fifties to competitive powerlifters and CrossFit athletes.

We do not believe in promising what we cannot deliver. No gimmicks, no transformation timelines, no before-after walls. We help you build a habit that sticks, at your own pace, under proper supervision.

pillars.title: Qualified Coaching
pillars.text: Every coach holds a recognised certification. We hire for teaching ability, not lifting numbers.

pillars.title: Well-Maintained Gear
pillars.text: Racks, bars and machines are serviced on a fixed schedule. Broken equipment is fixed or replaced within 48 hours.

pillars.title: Community Over Ego
pillars.text: You train alongside people at every level. Everyone is welcome and nobody gets judged.

props.label: Memberships
props.heading: Plans built for every schedule
props.sub: All plans include full gym access, locker room, and a free fitness assessment. No joining fee on monthly and quarterly plans. Annual plans come with two complimentary personal training sessions.

items.title: Monthly
items.desc: Flexible month-to-month membership with full access to all equipment and group classes. Ideal if you are trying us out or have an unpredictable schedule.

items.title: Quarterly
items.desc: Three months of unlimited training at a reduced rate. Includes a nutrition guidance session and one body composition analysis.

items.title: Annual
items.desc: Our best value — a full year of training with two complimentary personal training sessions, unlimited workshops, and priority class booking.

props.label: Free Trial
props.heading: Come train with us — on us
props.sub:
Book a free trial and experience the gym yourself. A coach will show you around and take you through a short workout — no pressure, no pitch.

Consult your doctor before starting a new programme, especially if you have a medical condition or have been inactive for long.

images.alt: Main training floor with rig and platforms

props.label: Timings
props.heading: When we're open
props.note: Group classes run 6:00–8:00 AM and 5:00–8:00 PM daily. Full timetables are available at the front desk and in the member app.

items.quote: Started here two years ago having never touched a barbell. The coaches broke everything down step by step, and now I am training five days a week and actually look forward to it. The community is what keeps me coming back.
items.name: Suresh

items.quote: I was nervous about joining a gym in my forties — thought I would be out of place. Iron Bridge is the opposite of that. People of all ages and fitness levels train here, and nobody judges. The coaches are brilliant at scaling workouts.
items.name: Lakshmi

items.quote: Tried three gyms before this one. Most are either crowded or the equipment is always broken. Iron Bridge keeps the floor clean, the racks are well-maintained, and the vibe is serious but friendly. Exactly what I needed.
items.name: Imran

props.label: Contact
props.heading: Get in touch
props.sub:
Call, WhatsApp or drop by — we would love to meet you. For urgent queries, calling is fastest.

Before starting any exercise programme, please consult a doctor, especially if you have a pre-existing medical condition.

CONTENT MODEL: Uses 'services' for membership plans with transparent pricing (monthly ₹1,999, quarterly ₹5,097, annual ₹14,999) using the manifest's price and meta fields. 'Team' lists trainers without photographs, following salon.json's precedent — no stock-photo face is captioned with a made-up name and certification. 'Appointment' drives free trial bookings with a compulsory services dropdown (Gym Tour / Free Trial Workout / Meet a Coach). 'Stats' uses only verifiable numbers (8+ years, 1,200+ members, 15 trainers, 8,000 sq ft) — no invented awards. 'Hours' shows a 5:30 AM–10 PM schedule with a class timetable note.

HEALTH CLAIMS: Copy deliberately avoids promising weight loss, transformation timelines, or any medical or therapeutic outcome. Trainers are described as coaches with certifications, not medical practitioners. Both the appointment section and contact section advise consulting a doctor before starting a new exercise programme — matching what a responsible gym actually says.

PRICING: Membership rates are set at realistic Indian urban gym levels as of mid-2026. The monthly plan at ₹1,999 is positioned as a flexible entry point; quarterly and annual plans offer progressively better value. These should be verified against the gym's actual rates before going live.

NO INVENTED FACES: All six trainer entries are first-name-only with no photographs, matching the salon.json approach. The gym should add its own team photos before publishing.

IMAGES: All photos are hosted Unsplash URLs using the ?auto=format&fit=crop&w=...&q=80 pattern. They must be replaced with the gym's own facility photography before going live.

BUSINESS INFO: Address is set to JP Nagar, Bengaluru — a real neighbourhood with an active fitness community. Hours reflect a typical Indian urban gym schedule (early morning to late evening, open every day). A single-location gym should update these to its actual details.

TERMS: Footer includes a termsBody with a basic health disclaimer (membership fees, medical pause policy, train-at-your-own-risk). The gym should replace this with its own terms reviewed by a legal advisor.
